title: SG-1.2 Write pure grid-to-pixels and sprite-sheet functions
summary: Recreate gridToRgba and buildSpriteSheet as pure functions in the game frontend, with unit tests
description: Context: SG-1.1 is done (game/frontend/src/lib/palette.ts exports PALETTE, 48 colours or fewer). The last check found that neither gridToRgba nor buildSpriteSheet exists in any source or test file under game/, although earlier artefacts report 16 passing tests. Desired behaviour: pure functions convert a palette-indexed grid to RGBA and lay frames out into one sheet, with unit tests for width, height, frame count, palette-only colours and out-of-range index rejection. Why: SG-1.3 (PNG script and manifest update) needs these functions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a palette-indexed grid, when gridToRgba runs, then the result has the grid's width and height and every pixel colour is in the shared palette
Given a grid containing an index outside the palette range, when gridToRgba runs, then it throws
Given N equal-size frames, when buildSpriteSheet runs, then the sheet reports frameCount N and width equal to N times the frame width
Given the same input twice, when either function runs, then the output bytes are identical

out_of_scope: new rooms, story content, backend, audio, deployment, repository clean-up
preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin and its guard tests

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix and Zustand stay
Functions are pure and deterministic; no downloaded art, image services or CDN links
One shared palette of at most 48 colours, defined once in palette.ts
Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked
Earlier unmerged work and .devion/worktrees are not read or copied
definition_of_done: Both functions exist, are exported and typecheck
Unit tests import them and pass
non_functional: Output is byte-identical on repeated runs
